headline: Weathered Expanse Heaviest Front; Wardens Gain at Nevish Line
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has become the heaviest station on the board, its lines now levelled at three works apiece with three more unclaimed, the Colonial lead reported in the last edition having been erased there; nine actions in the past two hours and forty-nine across the day make it the busiest district anywhere. At the Nevish Line the Wardens have added a work and now hold six to two Colonial, none unclaimed, with losses still climbing near 685 Colonial and 614 Warden in the past hour, the sharpest rate on the map. Linn Mercy stands ten Colonial works to one unclaimed, fighting about Lathair continuing. Marban Hollow holds four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed, Checkpoint Bua alone the scene of twenty-one actions. Mooring County remains eleven Warden to one Colonial, The Wind Hills the centre of its work. Callahan's Passage is the costliest posting, some 172 Colonial and 124 Warden losses the hour, while Stonecradle reports heavy casualties with scarcely any ground changing hands. The wider map remains overwhelmingly Colonial, Warden strength massed in the north and west.
